name: overlapping-turns
why: pyannote 3.1 emits overlapping speech, and two of the overlapping turns can be the SAME speaker. This fixture is built so accumulation is decisive rather than cosmetic: A's two turns overlap the word by 600 ms and 400 ms, B's single turn by 750 ms. Take the best single turn per speaker and B wins with 750 over 600; accumulate per speaker as the code does and A wins with 1000. The resulting margin of 0.14 is correctly low — this is genuinely contested audio.
